AI × Film

Hollywood made the OpenAI movie. It opens Christmas Day.

Artificial, from director Luca Guadagnino, tells how OpenAI and ChatGPT began, with Andrew Garfield as Sam Altman, Ike Barinholtz as Elon Musk, Monica Barbaro as Mira Murati and Yura Borisov as Ilya Sutskever. Amazon MGM let the film go; NEON picked it up for about $40 million, per Variety.

The story of AI is now a studio picture.

Follow @framexgod for AI × film news.

Sources: Far Out Magazine, HollywoodLife, Variety.
